why.text: Hot, dry Pannonian summers softened by the steppe lake's warmth, humidity and autumn fog, on loess, chernozem, gravel and sandy soils.

styles.text: Red Zweigelt, plain or Reserve, plus sweet white wines from overripe or raisined grapes.

climate.text: Centre of the Pannonian climate zone: dry, hot summers and cold winters with little snow. The 300 km2 lake releases stored heat at night; humidity and autumn fog mark ripening.

soil.text: Loess and chernozem on the north-east shore; gravel, sandy and saline soils in the Seewinkel. Zweigelt prefers the nutrient-poor southern soils.

tastes.text: Zweigelt: fruity, spicy, muted deep red, ripe sour cherry or plum. Reserve: vanilla, chocolate, ripe tannins. Sweet wines: tropical fruit; edelsüß: nut, honey, caramel.

styles.name: Reserve
styles.text: Zweigelt aged in large wood or barrique, at least 13.0% alcohol.

styles.name: Fruchtsüß
styles.text: Spätlese or Auslese from white grapes, at least 45 g/l unfermented sugar.

styles.name: Edelsüß
styles.text: Beerenauslese or Trockenbeerenauslese from raisined white grapes, with Botrytis nut and honey notes.

styles.name: Seewinkel
styles.text: Sweet wines may name it if grapes come from Apetlon, Illmitz or Podersdorf.
